MEDD 411.title: Foundations of Medical Practice I
MEDD 411.description: Integrating foundational and clinical sciences and clinical practice themes. Case-based approach fostering the development of evidence-based clinical reasoning and clinical skills. Organized on the basis of clinical presentations. Pass/fail.

MEDD 412.title: Foundations of Medical Practice II
MEDD 412.description: Increasingly complex clinical presentations through integration of foundational and clinical sciences and clinical practice themes. Developmental, case-based approach fostering the development of evidence-based clinical reasoning and clinical skills. Pass/fail.

MEDD 419.title: Foundations of Scholarship and Flexible Enhanced Learning I
MEDD 419.description: Various medically-related learning experiences and scholarly activities. Emphasizes social accountability, introduces scholarly methods, and fosters innovation, creativity, and critical thought to prepare graduates for roles as scholars, lifelong learners, and leaders. Pass/fail.

MEDD 421.title: Foundations of Medical Practice III
MEDD 421.description: Increasingly complex clinical presentations integrating foundational sciences and clinical practice themes. Developmental, case-based approach fostering the development of evidence-based clinical reasoning and clinical skills. Pass/Fail.

MEDD 422.title: Foundations of Medical Practice IV and Transition into Clinical Education
MEDD 422.description: Prepares students to transition from classroom-based to clinical learning environments. Increasingly complex clinical presentations integrating foundational sciences and clinical practice themes. Prepares students for clinical practice in Year 3 Clerkship. Pass/Fail.

MEDD 429.title: Flexible Enhanced Learning II
MEDD 429.description: Opportunity to build on scholarly activities initiated in MEDD_V 419, or start new ones. Emphasizes social accountability and fosters innovation, creativity, and critical thought to prepare graduates for roles as scholars, lifelong learners, and leaders. Pass/Fail.

MEDD 431.title: Clerkship
MEDD 431.description: Core experiences across the breadth of medicine through clinical and academic learning opportunities in ambulatory, hospital-based, and rural/remote settings. Interactions with patients under supervision. Pass/Fail.

MEDD 440.title: Senior Elective
MEDD 440.description: Senior Elective encompasses 6 months of Year 4 of the MD undergraduate program. Students will choose from available electives between 2 and 4 weeks in duration and participate in all relevant clinical and academic activities associated with those electives. Pass/fail.

MEDD 448.title: Transition into Postgraduate Education and Practice
MEDD 448.description: Enables students to effectively transition from medical school to residency and medical practice. Complex clinical presentations that integrate foundational sciences and practice themes. Prepares students for practice as residents and physicians. Pass/Fail.

MEDD 449.title: Flexible Enhanced Learning III
MEDD 449.description: Opportunity to build on scholarly activities initiated in MEDD_V 419 and 429, or start new ones. Emphasizes social accountability and fosters innovation and critical thought to prepare graduates for roles as scholars, lifelong learners, and leaders. Pass/Fail.

MEDD 451.title: Clinical Skills IV
MEDD 451.description: Final examination for fourth year encompassing all clinical subjects. Pass/Fail.

MEDD 499.title: Clinical Electives
MEDD 499.description: Summer clinical experience for UBC medical graduates who did not attain a residency position.

children.raw: Students must have a UBC MD degree and have fully completed applications to residency positions for the first iteration of the postgraduate match in their Year 4
submission of a Rank Order List to the Canadian Residency Matching Service, CaRMS)

MEDD 499.prerequisiteText: Students must have a UBC MD degree and have fully completed applications to residency positions for the first iteration of the postgraduate match in their Year 4 (submission of a Rank Order List to the Canadian Residency Matching Service, CaRMS). Pass/Fail
